assumptions: CONJECTURE: at least one actual coordinate factor base induces repeated exact recursive transition behavior under a non-injective observation that survives orientation and identity refinement.
RESTRICTED THEOREM: the full denominator-cleared f3 coefficient observation is generically injective when a source branch has two distinct mapped x-values and is therefore only a negative control.
RESTRICTED THEOREM: complete all-target two-orientation compatibility multiplicities distinguish every x-orbit for any nonempty proper complement set in an odd prime-order group.
RESTRICTED THEOREM: over Q or C, complete prime-cycle translation profiles are linearly independent, so an exact linear-profile module has no dimension compression.
UNTESTED: a quotient smaller than the full x-orbit universe can be queried without reconstructing a target-specific full-state mask.
MODEL-BOUND: exact finite-state partition refinement is a barrier or compiler diagnostic, not a lower bound for all algebraic algorithms.
TOY-EVIDENCE: exhaustive state and witness reconstruction is feasible only on generated small curves.
falsification_conditions: The coarsest exact partition has more than 0.8 times as many classes as the full state universe on either seed at any size.
The coordinate quotient is not at least 20 percent smaller or cheaper than its map-matched randomized null on identical targets.
Transition refinement depends on representative choice, loses an identity route, or fails exact signed witness lifting.
A query materializes a target-specific vector, mask, coefficient list, or compatibility table with more than 0.8 times the D2 x-orbit count.
Advice, live workspace, or online field work exceeds 0.8 times the symmetry-D3 or exact D2+D3 comparator under any registered weight.
interpretation_limits: A quotient pass is permission to build a compiled-query successor, not an exponent result or ECDLP break.
A singleton-partition result is scoped to the registered exact transition semantics and factor-base maps.
The linear-rank result does not rule out full-rank structured transforms, nonlinear first-witness operators, restricted target distributions, or finite-characteristic exceptional reductions.
Hash collisions may accelerate indexing but never establish class equality.
Relation collection, matrix rank, sparse linear algebra, and individual logarithm descent remain outside this preflight.
hypothesis.mechanism: Construct orientation-aware S2 and S3 x-orbit transition systems from actual source-map factor roots, compute the coarsest exact source-labeled partition that preserves symbolic target compatibility and witness lifting, and query only quotient states without constructing G_Q, H_Q, or a full target-state mask.

predictions.metric: exact quotient classes versus full recursive state orbits
predictions.minimum_effect: at most 0.8x on both seeds at every size

predictions.metric: quotient classes, advice, or transition work versus map-matched randomized roots
predictions.minimum_effect: at most 0.8x without support or witness loss

predictions.metric: largest target-specific live state versus D2 x-orbit count
predictions.minimum_effect: at most 0.8x with no hidden full-state reconstruction

predictions.metric: online weighted field work versus exact D2+D3
predictions.minimum_effect: at most 0.8x for inversion weights 10, 50, and 100

hypothesis.statement: At least one actual elliptic-coordinate factor base admits a target-independent exact quotient of recursive S3 transition states that is composable, witness-liftable, smaller than its map-matched random control, and queryable without materializing a full target-conditioned state vector.

test_boundary.implementation: No implementation is authorized until theory, literature, and red-team reviews approve the exact state and quotient definitions.
